title: Commit the root composer.lock and install from it outside range jobs (D4)
summary: Removes `composer.lock` from `.gitignore`, commits the root lock (resolved on PHP 8.3, the floor) in its own commit, and switches every workflow job that is not a version-range job from `composer update` to `composer install`; range jobs (matrix key `laravel` or `stability`) keep `composer update`. Composer cache keys include `composer.lock`.
why: Owner D4 (A10 of the audit): qualification without a root lock is not reproducible, and P2.1 `composer audit --locked` / OSV lockfile scans need it. Risks: a lock resolved on PHP 8.4 breaks `composer install` on 8.3 jobs; a stale local lock silently changes dependency versions — the lock must match the currently installed `vendor/` or be refreshed only with owner approval; mixing this commit with runtime changes violates conventions item 2.

include: `.gitignore`: delete the `composer.lock` line (line 12); keep `packages/*/composer.lock` ignored if such a pattern exists, otherwise add `packages/*/composer.lock`

Root `composer.lock`: if `composer validate --strict` reports the local lock as current and `composer install --dry-run` reports nothing to install/update, commit it as is; otherwise ask the owner before `composer update --no-interaction` (a dependency update) and record the diff of `composer show --locked` before/after in the evidence

Workflows: `tests.yml` jobs `test-replica`, `test-redis`, `coverage`, `consumer-fixture` and any other non-range job; `tests-nightly.yml` jobs without a `laravel`/`stability` matrix; `mutation.yml`, `bench.yml`, `compatibility.yml`, `static-analysis.yml`, `code-style.yml`, `release.yml` `validate` — use `composer install --prefer-dist --no-interaction --no-progress`
`RELEASING.md` and `DEVELOPMENT.md`: one sentence each — the root lock is the development/release lock; packages never ship it; range jobs re-resolve
exclude: Dependency upgrades beyond what an out-of-date lock requires

reads.why: Branch, commits, owner WIP, frozen-contract stop rule, owner gates, evidence
Exact local commands, PHP 8.4 shim, docker ports
Range vs non-range jobs and install steps
config.platform, scripts; whether a platform pin exists

rules: Commit 1 contains only `.gitignore` and `composer.lock`; commit 2 the workflow and doc changes.

Generate or verify the lock with PHP 8.3 (`php` default); if a `composer install` job runs PHP 8.4/8.5 and fails on platform, add root `config.platform.php` = the lowest supported 8.3 patch instead of re-resolving on a newer PHP.
guidance: Create the branch first (conventions item 1). Check `composer validate --strict` (it fails on a stale lock). The UPDATE_CHECK validation classifies a job as a range job by its matrix keys; a job with a `laravel` matrix that pins `laravel/framework` through `composer require --no-update` before `composer update` stays a range job.

validation.cmd: ! git check-ignore -q composer.lock && git ls-files --error-unmatch composer.lock

python3 -c 'import yaml,glob,sys; bad=[(f,j) for f in glob.glob(".github/workflows/*.yml") for j,v in (yaml.safe_load(open(f)).get("jobs") or {}).items() for s in v.get("steps",[]) if "composer update" in str(s.get("run","")) and not ({"laravel","stability"} & set(((v.get("strategy") or {}).get("matrix") or {}).keys()))]; print(bad); sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)'

validation.procedure: Push per knowledge/execution#ci-evidence (gate CI-PUSH) and run the ci-runs check for Tests, Static Analysis, Code Style, Compatibility
validation.expect: all named workflows success on HEAD

deliverables: Workflows install from the lock outside range jobs

result.notes: Lock committed (commit 1: .gitignore + composer.lock, PHP 8.3 lock current, no update needed). Non-range jobs now composer install; cache keys include composer.lock; docs updated. V6 (live CI) not run: needs owner gate CI-PUSH.
